title: Trump administration is suspending Microsoft from a green card program
author: alephnerd
aiHeadline: Microsoft, the company that literally wrote the book on software, gets suspended from a green card program—because apparently, even tech giants need a reminder that they're not above the law, especially when it comes to visa shenanigans.

title: Tell HN: I've been paying for a rural Tanzanian's education for 10 years
author: lukehandcool
aiHeadline: One kind soul has been footing the bill for a Tanzanian student's education for a decade—talk about investing in the future, or at least ensuring that someone else's kid grows up to be smarter than you.

title: Whistle: Speech to Text in 16.9 MB
author: gmays
aiHeadline: Introducing Whistle: a speech-to-text model so small it could fit in your pocket, proving once again that sometimes, less is more—unless you're trying to transcribe a lecture on quantum physics, in which case, good luck.

title: “Math 2.0” will need to value mathematical progress more holistically
author: ent101
aiHeadline: Math 2.0 is here, and it's supposedly going to revolutionize the field by being more holistic—because clearly, the current state of mathematical progress is so narrow-minded that it's failing to account for the fact that mathematicians are actual human beings with feelings.

title: I gave Opus 5.5 one prompt and six hours to visualize Invisible Cities
author: stared
aiHeadline: AI gets a creative prompt and six hours to visualize 'Invisible Cities,' proving that even machines can get lost in a world of imagination—though let's be honest, it probably took longer to write the prompt than it did to generate the images.
